title: Mark D NDE 3203
content: I drew the baddest bucking bull on earth. In the indoors winter rodeo bullriding event, the bull roared out of the chute. With a really high jump, when he hit the ground the force threw me forward. As he was coming up for jump, he knocked me with a blow to my chest. He then began to spin. On the third spin, I was beginning to fly towards his outside. I hit the chute gate with my head. My dad said I went straight down the gate like jumping out of a moving truck into a brick wall. The next thing I know, I'm up on the ceiling at least 40 or 50 feet looking down. I watched my equipment being taken off me and worried that it was all going different directions. I watched the ambulance back into the arena and watched them put me in the ambulance. As I was up there looking down there was tremendous light behind me. I knew I was up there with the lights, but I knew this light was brighter than the building lights. Something told me to not look back into the light, so I didn't. I woke up 3 hours later in the hospital. I rode the next night in a different event. I don't know what my signs were, but I know that I was not in my body. My arms and legs were outside my body and I was just floating. I saw everything going on below

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes AccidentDirect head injury indoor intercollegant rodeo I drawed the prca bucking bull of the year crowned 1 month earlier in oklahoma city national finals rodeo Other not sure never really heard but was knocked out for over 3 hours.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness while looking down from above
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I don't remember hearing anything at all
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes it was blinding light I didn't see it but could feel it behind me
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: worry free except about my gear and equipment but I only thought about that stuff when people were walking away with it
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I didn't hear a real voice, only one inside me. It said to not look back into the light. I didn't even consider looking back, I just watched forward which was straight down at my body
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I have told many people, but still need to tell my mother. I don't know that I've told her
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. I know what happened and I know it was real I was a glance from being gone
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I think it be interesting to know if anybody else has been where I have
